summary: The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate funding, arguing that it is essential for providing internet access to students and the public, and that disconnection and under-education are detrimental. The comment emphasizes the importance of the education department and the need to maintain educational access for children.

claims.argument: Taking away funding will cause more disconnection and under-education
claims.evidence_quote: All public schools and libraries should be given the funding to allow students and and anyone else to be able to access the internet. By taking this funding away, it will cause more people to be disconnected and under educated.
